description: Covers the Role Management operations not already provided by API-003 (Create Role) and API-005 (Assign Role to User): listing, viewing, updating, and toggling role availability on `roles`.

reused_apis.note: Role creation is already covered - not duplicated here.

success.status_definition: N/A - blocked pending schema change, see schema_gap below

response.error: Role activation/deactivation is not supported: roles has no is_active column

operations.schema_gap_note: database/schema/001_core_setup.sql defines `roles` with no is_active (or deleted_at) column - unlike users.is_active, department_master.is_active, and test_master.is_active, which all exist. There is currently no way to deactivate a role without deleting it (which would violate the roles.id FK from role_permission, menu_permission, user_roles). DB/Schema confirmation required: add `roles.is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE` before this operation can be implemented. The contract above documents the intended request/response shape for when that column exists.

notes: Net-new contract; no e2e-validation or api_contracts_test coverage exists yet. Activate/Deactivate Role is blocked on a schema change - see schema_gap_note.
